title.zh: 佩嘉妮 · 天光合轴与分支终结
title.en: Pyrois / Astra / Nicole · Celestial Light overlap and Ultimate branches

summary.zh: 依据璐洛洛明确的耀佩妮推荐与天光合轴操作，由本站按固定技能整理条件教学；喧响不足时不强求双Q，没有固定秒轴或最高分承诺。
summary.en: Site teaching combines Ruroro’s explicit Astra/Pyrois/Nicole recommendation and Celestial Light overlap with fixed skills. Double Ultimates require real Decibels; no timed or maximum-score guarantee.

conditions.zh: 本站依据原作者正文与固定Gachabase整理条件教学，不是已观看视频逐帧复刻、固定秒轴或最高分保证。
conditions.en: Site-authored conditional teaching combines original written guides and fixed Gachabase; it is not a reproduction of watched footage, a timed script, or a maximum-score guarantee.

conditions.zh: 默认0影、无专武也按实际资源执行；影画/专武只改变注明条件，不凭总金数赠送资源。所有Q使用各自喧响。
conditions.en: At M0 without signatures, act on actual resources; configurations change only the stated conditions, not resources granted by total investment. Every Ultimate uses its own character’s Decibels.

conditions.zh: 站位嘉音→妮可→佩洛伊斯，让嘉音初始/转换入口给妮可，再由妮可命中交佩；三人以太/支援条件满足，不假定浸染。
conditions.en: Order Astra→Nicole→Pyrois sends Astra’s initial/converted entry to Nicole, then Nicole’s hit to Pyrois. Ether/Support conditions are met; Contamination is not assumed.

conditions.zh: 本队没有击破位；嘉音转换连携并不制造失衡。爆发段先等目标真实失衡，常态按实际资源与安全窗口输出。
conditions.en: There is no Stun specialist. Astra’s converted Chains do not cause Stun; the burst phase waits for actual Stun, while ordinary damage follows resources and safe windows.

label.zh: 璐洛洛 · 佩洛伊斯天光合轴与耀佩妮（3.0）
label.en: Ruroro · Pyrois Celestial Light overlap and Astra/Pyrois/Nicole (3.0)

label.zh: HoYo青枫 · 耀嘉音驻唱与精准支援（1.5）
label.en: HoYo Qingfeng · Astra Cadenza and Perfect Assists (1.5)

label.zh: 耀嘉音 · 固定Gachabase 3.3
label.en: Astra Yao · fixed Gachabase 3.3

label.zh: 玲珑妆匣 · 固定Gachabase 3.3
label.en: Elegant Vanity · fixed Gachabase 3.3

label.en: Pyrois · fixed Gachabase 3.3

label.zh: 日冕遗蜕 · 固定Gachabase 3.3
label.en: Sol Exuvia · fixed Gachabase 3.3

label.en: Nicole · fixed Gachabase 3.3

label.zh: 开局准备
label.en: Opening

objective.zh: 驻唱、能量场与长期耀斑，按资源启动
objective.en: Set Cadenza, field and long-lasting Sunflare as resources allow

title.zh: 嘉音点E驻唱，命中后交快支
title.en: Tap Astra Special, then follow the actual assist

input.zh: 点按特殊技命中目标；已经驻唱时切回嘉音会自动衔接此招，不再重复长按。
input.en: Tap Special and hit the target; returning to Astra during Cadenza automatically links this skill, so do not add a redundant hold.

trigger.zh: 需要建立/恢复驻唱，或为主攻制造合法入场；无需满能开唱。
trigger.en: Cadenza or a legal carry entry needs restoring; starting it does not require full Energy.

complete.zh: 确认驻唱与快支提示；实际入场时嘉音有25能量才追加震音并施加核心加攻。
complete.en: Confirm Cadenza and the assist prompt; Astra needs 25 Energy at entry to fire Tremolo and grant the core ATK buff.

reason.zh: 开唱、命中生成快支和耗能加攻是不同条件。
reason.en: Starting Cadenza, hitting to create an assist, and spending Energy for ATK are separate conditions.

fallback.zh: 打空则重新瞄准；没有对应快支就普通切换并跳过下一快支步骤，不计精准支援加攻。
fallback.en: Re-aim after a miss; without the corresponding prompt, switch normally and skip the next assist step without claiming its ATK proc.

signal.zh: 对应角色的快支提示实际出现。
signal.en: The corresponding character’s Quick Assist prompt actually appears.

input.zh: 仅在该角色快支提示出现时按切换键。
input.en: Press Switch only when this character’s Quick Assist prompt appears.

trigger.zh: 前一步实际命中并生成对应提示，站位符合本方案。
trigger.en: The previous action actually hit and produced the matching prompt, with the required squad order.

complete.zh: 确认该角色通过快速支援接手；嘉音实际耗能才计入场加攻。
complete.en: Confirm this character entered through Quick Assist; count the entry ATK buff only if Astra actually spent Energy.

reason.zh: 普通切换与快速支援分开，避免虚构资源和增益。
reason.en: Separate ordinary switching from Quick Assist to avoid fictitious resources or buffs.

fallback.zh: 提示已消失则普通切入；希格莉德快支不是出枪式，佩洛伊斯仍需30日珥才接天光第三段。
fallback.en: If the prompt expired, switch normally. Sigrid’s Quick Assist is not Unbridled Spear; Pyrois still needs 30 Solar Prominence for the Celestial Light stage-3 shortcut.

label.zh: 嘉音切控后仍在前场驻唱；队友真实支援/连携入场且嘉音耗25能量，才给该入场角色加攻。
label.en: Astra stays on stage in Cadenza after control changes; an actual assist/Chain entry and her 25-Energy spend are required for that entrant’s ATK buff.

title.zh: 妮可EX命中，能量场接主攻
title.en: Land Nicole EX and pass control through the field

input.zh: 妮可能量足时点按EX；需要更长能量场且有余能才蓄力，命中后接佩洛伊斯快支。
input.en: Tap Nicole EX with enough Energy; charge only when a longer field and spare Energy justify it, then take Pyrois’s assist after the hit.

trigger.zh: 需要刷新减防/以太增伤，目标在射程内且有EX能量。
trigger.en: DEF reduction/Ether support needs refreshing, the target is in range, and EX Energy is available.

complete.zh: 能量场实际命中才刷新3.5秒减防/以太增伤，并出现快支；离开场或停止命中不能视为永久覆盖。
complete.en: Actual field hits refresh the 3.5s DEF/Ether effects and produce the assist; leaving the field or ceasing hits does not preserve them indefinitely.

reason.zh: 趁佩洛伊斯天光第三段已启动时切妮，第四段可后台完成；不为提前切走的失败动作记伤害。
reason.en: Switch to Nicole after Celestial Light stage 3 starts so stage 4 can finish off-field; premature switching does not create that background hit.

fallback.zh: 能量不足先用强化子弹命中续减防，或等实际连携；没有快支则普通回佩并跳过快支步骤，不假设拿到快捷天光入口。
fallback.en: With insufficient Energy, hit with enhanced bullets to refresh DEF reduction or wait for a real Chain. Without an assist, return normally and skip its step; do not assume its stage-3 shortcut.

label.zh: 嘉音切控后仍在前场驻唱；队友真实支援/连携入场且嘉音耗25能量，才给该入场角色加攻。
label.en: Astra stays on stage in Cadenza after control changes; an actual assist/Chain entry and her 25-Energy spend are required for that entrant’s ATK buff.

signal.zh: 妮可EX实际命中，下一位佩洛伊斯快支提示出现。
signal.en: Nicole EX actually hits and the next-slot Pyrois assist prompt appears.

input.zh: 仅在该角色快支提示出现时按切换键。
input.en: Press Switch only when this character’s Quick Assist prompt appears.

trigger.zh: 前一步实际命中并生成对应提示，站位符合本方案。
trigger.en: The previous action actually hit and produced the matching prompt, with the required squad order.

label.en: Astra stays on stage in Cadenza after control changes; an actual assist/Chain entry and her 25-Energy spend are required for that entrant’s ATK buff.

input.zh: 本人喧响到特且Q可选时按Q，选向下分支。
input.en: With his own Decibels at Very High and Ultimate available, use Q and choose the downward branch.

trigger.zh: 耀斑尚未建立/已结束，且实际Q资源足够；0影不承诺开局即用。
trigger.en: Sunflare is absent/expired and the actual Ultimate resource is sufficient; M0 does not promise an immediate opener.

complete.zh: 发动获得200秒耀斑；之后EX实际完美格挡才额外回日珥，2影回喧响另有180秒冷却。
complete.en: Activation grants 200s Sunflare; subsequent EX needs a real Perfect Block for bonus Prominence. The M2 Decibel refund has a separate 180s cooldown.

reason.zh: 这是长期准备分支，已覆盖时不用每轮重开。
reason.en: This is a long-lasting setup branch, not a mandatory repeat every cycle.

fallback.zh: Q未好或耀斑仍在就跳过；上一实际快支后可按日珥接天光，入口已断则回普攻。
fallback.en: Skip if unavailable or Flare persists. After the preceding actual Quick Assist, use Celestial Light by resource; if that entry was lost, return to Basics.

label.zh: 嘉音切控后仍在前场驻唱；队友真实支援/连携入场且嘉音耗25能量，才给该入场角色加攻。
label.en: Astra stays on stage in Cadenza after control changes; an actual assist/Chain entry and her 25-Energy spend are required for that entrant’s ATK buff.

title.zh: 按日珥打天光，足量才续
title.en: Spend actual Prominence on Celestial Light

input.zh: 合法EX/快支/Q后且日珥≥30长按普攻直进第三段；连携后可点按或长按。
input.en: After a legal EX/Quick Assist/Ultimate with 30+ Prominence, hold Basic into stage 3; after Chain, press or hold is valid.

trigger.zh: 实际日珥至少30且前置快捷入口成立；普通直接长按从第一段开始。
trigger.en: Actual Prominence is at least 30 and the shortcut entry exists; a standalone hold instead begins at stage 1.

complete.zh: 确认第三段已经发动；切控后才自动续第四段。没有切人则让动作正常完成。
complete.en: Confirm stage 3 activated; switching during it makes stage 4 continue off-field. Without switching, let the action finish normally.

reason.zh: 阳炎期间在第四段仍有≥30日珥才可长按再接第三段，不默认两套。
reason.en: During Mirage, another stage-3 loop from stage 4 requires 30+ remaining Prominence; two batches are not automatic.

fallback.zh: 资源不足跳过、回普攻积累；前置已断则用普通完整天光或重新取得快捷入口，后台续招未开始不作合轴。
fallback.en: If underfunded, skip and rebuild with Basics. If the shortcut expired, use the full normal sequence or regain an entry; no background continuation is assumed before startup.

label.zh: 嘉音切控后仍在前场驻唱；队友真实支援/连携入场且嘉音耗25能量，才给该入场角色加攻。
label.en: Astra stays on stage in Cadenza after control changes; an actual assist/Chain entry and her 25-Energy spend are required for that entrant’s ATK buff.

prep.zh: 嘉音无能量也能开唱；妮可EX不足时先恢复，不能因此虚构交给佩的快支。
prep.en: Astra can start singing without Energy; if Nicole lacks EX Energy, recover first instead of inventing a Pyrois assist.

prep.zh: 0影起手喧响不一定足够下Q；已有30日珥可先利用实际快支接天光，之后有Q再补耀斑。
prep.en: M0 may lack the opening downward Ultimate; 30 Prominence can instead fund Celestial Light after an actual assist, with Sunflare added when ready.

label.zh: 常态合轴
label.en: Normal overlap

objective.zh: 三段天光启动后交妮，第四段后台续上
objective.en: After Celestial Light stage 3 starts, hand to Nicole while stage 4 continues

title.zh: 佩洛伊斯普攻，积攒日珥与喧响
title.en: Build Solar Prominence and Decibels with Basics

input.zh: 在前场点按普攻命中目标，结合安全闪避，不强行站着挨打。
input.en: Use on-field Basics that hit, with safe dodges instead of forcing damage trades.

trigger.zh: 日珥、EX能量或自身Q尚未就绪；资源已有余量可缩短本段。
trigger.en: Solar Prominence, EX Energy or his own Ultimate is not ready; shorten this segment when already funded.

complete.zh: 按实际资源条停止：日珥上限60、天光入口至少30；时间流逝不保证一套普攻补满。
complete.en: Stop by the actual gauges: Prominence caps at 60 and Celestial Light needs 30 to enter; one Basic string does not guarantee a refill.

reason.zh: 普通期为下一轮准备资源，不把作者高影开场喧响送给0影。
reason.en: Use downtime to prepare resources without granting an M0 character the author’s higher-Mindscape opener.

fallback.zh: 目标移开先追近；日珥低时继续命中积累，不空按天光。
fallback.en: Reposition when the target moves; continue building on-hit resources instead of forcing underfunded Celestial Light.

label.zh: 嘉音切控后仍在前场驻唱；队友真实支援/连携入场且嘉音耗25能量，才给该入场角色加攻。
label.en: Astra stays on stage in Cadenza after control changes; an actual assist/Chain entry and her 25-Energy spend are required for that entrant’s ATK buff.

title.zh: 日华：可选接攻击，建立天光快捷入口
title.en: Radiant EX: optional guard and a Celestial Light shortcut

input.zh: EX能量够时点按；若要完美格挡，必须让突进期间实际接到敌人攻击。
input.en: Tap with enough EX Energy; a Perfect Block requires an enemy attack actually hitting the rush.

trigger.zh: EX就绪；计划紧接天光时还要检查日珥≥30。
trigger.en: EX is ready; following with Celestial Light additionally requires 30+ Prominence.

complete.zh: EX发动后可在日珥≥30时长按直接第三段；只有耀斑有效且实际完美格挡才额外回10日珥。
complete.en: After EX, 30+ Prominence allows hold-Basic directly into stage 3. The extra 10 Prominence requires both Sunflare and a real Perfect Block.

reason.zh: 普通命中、完美格挡和日珥门槛分开；黄光本身不证明已格挡。
reason.en: Separate a normal hit, Perfect Block and resource threshold; a warning flash alone proves no guard.

fallback.zh: 能量不足回普攻；日珥不足先积累，不把EX发动就当必满30。
fallback.en: Return to Basics without Energy; build low Prominence instead of assuming EX activation guarantees 30.

label.zh: 嘉音切控后仍在前场驻唱；队友真实支援/连携入场且嘉音耗25能量，才给该入场角色加攻。
label.en: Astra stays on stage in Cadenza after control changes; an actual assist/Chain entry and her 25-Energy spend are required for that entrant’s ATK buff.

title.zh: 天光第三段启动后切妮可
title.en: Switch to Nicole after Celestial Light stage 3 starts

input.zh: 合法EX/快支/Q后且日珥≥30，长按普攻直进第三段；确认启动再切妮可。
input.en: After a legal EX/Quick Assist/Ultimate with 30+ Prominence, hold Basic directly into stage 3; switch to Nicole only after startup.

trigger.zh: 实际日珥至少30且前置快捷入口成立；普通直接长按从第一段开始。
trigger.en: Actual Prominence is at least 30 and the shortcut entry exists; a standalone hold instead begins at stage 1.

fallback.zh: 资源不足跳过、回普攻积累；前置已断则用普通完整天光或重新取得快捷入口，后台续招未开始不作合轴。
fallback.en: If underfunded, skip and rebuild with Basics. If the shortcut expired, use the full normal sequence or regain an entry; no background continuation is assumed before startup.

label.zh: 嘉音切控后仍在前场驻唱；队友真实支援/连携入场且嘉音耗25能量，才给该入场角色加攻。
label.en: Astra stays on stage in Cadenza after control changes; an actual assist/Chain entry and her 25-Energy spend are required for that entrant’s ATK buff.

signal.zh: 确认天光第三段已开始，再普通切妮可；第四段由原动作自动续上。
signal.en: Confirm Celestial Light stage 3 started, then switch normally to Nicole; the existing action automatically continues into stage 4.

title.en: Land Nicole EX and pass control through the field

reason.en: During Mirage, another stage-3 loop from stage 4 requires 30+ remaining Prominence; two batches are not automatic.

fallback.zh: 资源不足跳过、回普攻积累；前置已断则用普通完整天光或重新取得快捷入口，后台续招未开始不作合轴。
fallback.en: If underfunded, skip and rebuild with Basics. If the shortcut expired, use the full normal sequence or regain an entry; no background continuation is assumed before startup.

label.zh: 嘉音切控后仍在前场驻唱；队友真实支援/连携入场且嘉音耗25能量，才给该入场角色加攻。
label.en: Astra stays on stage in Cadenza after control changes; an actual assist/Chain entry and her 25-Energy spend are required for that entrant’s ATK buff.

prep.zh: 妮可减益只在实际命中后短时有效。嘉音已在场驻唱，若状态结束先恢复，不把她标成普通后台退场。
prep.en: Nicole’s debuffs last briefly after actual hits. Astra remains on stage in Cadenza; restore it if ended rather than labeling her as an ordinary off-field exit.

prep.zh: 日珥不足第二套时，最后天光跳过回普攻；一套循环不保证接下一套，保留实际目标位置与资源判断。
prep.en: If Prominence cannot fund the second batch, skip the final Celestial Light and return to Basics; each cycle is conditional on actual resources and target position.

label.zh: 失衡输出
label.en: Stun burst

objective.zh: 共享转换补喧响，上Q天光后有余量才右Q
objective.en: Use shared conversions, then upward Ultimate/Celestial Light; finish rightward only if funded

title.zh: 嘉音Q：开启两次共享转换
title.en: Astra Ultimate: enable two shared conversions

input.zh: 嘉音本人Q就绪时切回发动，确保命中；按随后提示接指定角色。
input.en: With Astra’s own Ultimate ready, switch to her, use it, and hit; take the following displayed entry.

trigger.zh: 本人喧响足够，剩余窗口允许；这不是队友开Q后的共享资源。
trigger.en: Her own Decibels are sufficient and the window allows it; teammates’ Ultimates do not supply a shared meter.

complete.zh: 下两次快支被替换为连携，次数全队共享；不因此让敌人失衡。
complete.en: The next two Quick Assists become Chains, shared across the squad; this does not itself make the enemy Stunned.

reason.zh: 转换提供真正的连携入口，但不是任意角色无限连携。
reason.en: Conversion supplies a real Chain entry, not unlimited Chains for any character.

fallback.zh: Q未好就跳过本步及依赖它的转换步骤，继续已有主攻资源；提示失效不强切当连携。
fallback.en: If unavailable, skip this and its dependent converted entries and spend existing carry resources; an expired prompt is not a Chain.

signal.zh: Q实际命中，指定角色的转换连携提示出现且有剩余次数。
signal.en: The Ultimate actually hits and the specified character’s converted Chain prompt appears with a charge remaining.

title.zh: 接妮可连携，命中再给佩洛伊斯
title.en: Take Nicole’s Chain, then pass its hit-generated entry

input.zh: 嘉音Q命中出现妮可的转换连携提示时按提示进入。
input.en: Enter when Astra Ultimate’s hit creates Nicole’s converted Chain prompt.

trigger.zh: 嘉音Q转换还有剩余，提示实际指向妮可；普通换人不算此招。
trigger.en: An Astra conversion remains and the actual prompt offers Nicole; ordinary switching is not this skill.

complete.zh: 妮可能量场命中产生佩洛伊斯快支；嘉音转换若还剩一次，它才替换为佩的连携。
complete.en: Nicole’s field hit creates Pyrois’s Quick Assist; only if an Astra conversion remains does it become his Chain.

reason.zh: 这两次转换是全队共享的两次，不能对两人各计两次。
reason.en: These are two shared conversions, not two per character.

fallback.zh: 第一提示失效则跳过；若只剩普通快支，按快支进入而不计佩连携的300喧响，后续重新检查Q。
fallback.en: Skip after an expired prompt. If only a normal Quick Assist remains, take it without counting Pyrois’s 300 Chain Decibels and recheck Ultimate availability.

label.zh: 嘉音切控后仍在前场驻唱；队友真实支援/连携入场且嘉音耗25能量，才给该入场角色加攻。
label.en: Astra stays on stage in Cadenza after control changes; an actual assist/Chain entry and her 25-Energy spend are required for that entrant’s ATK buff.

signal.zh: 妮可连携实际命中、嘉音转换尚有剩余，佩洛伊斯连携提示出现。
signal.en: Nicole’s Chain actually hits, an Astra conversion remains, and Pyrois’s Chain prompt appears.

title.zh: 佩洛伊斯连携，补本人喧响
title.en: Pyrois Chain restores his own Decibels

input.zh: 实际连携提示可选佩洛伊斯时进入。
input.en: Enter only when an actual Chain prompt offers Pyrois.

trigger.zh: 妮可后续快支已被嘉音剩余次数转换，或另有真实敌人连携；不得把普通快支当连携。
trigger.en: Nicole’s following assist was converted by a remaining Astra charge, or a separate real enemy Chain exists; a normal assist is not a Chain.

complete.zh: 本队支援满足额外能力，连携发动回300本人喧响；日珥≥30才接天光第三段。
complete.en: The Support teammate enables the Additional Ability: Chain activation restores 300 personal Decibels, while stage-3 Celestial Light still needs 30+ Prominence.

reason.zh: 嘉音给连携入口、佩自己回喧响，两种资源分别核对。
reason.en: Astra supplies the Chain entry and Pyrois restores his own Decibels; account for them separately.

fallback.zh: 没有连携则普通接手或按实际快支，跳过300喧响奖励并重新检查后面两个Q；未失衡时不要套用右Q决算。
fallback.en: Without Chain, enter normally or via the actual assist, omit the 300 reward and recheck both later Ultimates; do not apply the rightward payoff to a non-Stunned enemy.

label.zh: 嘉音切控后仍在前场驻唱；队友真实支援/连携入场且嘉音耗25能量，才给该入场角色加攻。
label.en: Astra stays on stage in Cadenza after control changes; an actual assist/Chain entry and her 25-Energy spend are required for that entrant’s ATK buff.

title.zh: 上Q补日珥，建立阳炎爆发
title.en: Upward Ultimate refills Prominence for Mirage

input.zh: 佩洛伊斯本人Q就绪且目标失衡时按Q，选向上分支。
input.en: With Pyrois’s own Ultimate ready and the target Stunned, use Q and choose upward.

trigger.zh: 当前真实喧响足够；优先确认辅助覆盖与剩余窗口，不借嘉音的喧响。
trigger.en: His actual Decibels are sufficient; verify support coverage and remaining time without borrowing Astra’s gauge.

complete.zh: 发动补30日珥并获得21秒阳炎；日珥仍受60上限约束，后续天光逐次消耗。
complete.en: Activation adds 30 Prominence and grants 21s Mirage; Prominence remains capped at 60 and subsequent Celestial Light spends it.

reason.zh: 阳炎支持后续天光与对失衡目标的终结爆发，不能推出必有第二Q。
reason.en: Mirage supports subsequent Celestial Light and Ultimate damage against Stunned targets, but does not guarantee another Ultimate.

fallback.zh: Q未好就跳过，用连携后的≥30日珥接天光；日珥也不足则回普通期。
fallback.en: If unavailable, skip and use the Chain shortcut with 30+ Prominence; if that is also unavailable, return to the normal phase.

label.zh: 嘉音切控后仍在前场驻唱；队友真实支援/连携入场且嘉音耗25能量，才给该入场角色加攻。
label.en: Astra stays on stage in Cadenza after control changes; an actual assist/Chain entry and her 25-Energy spend are required for that entrant’s ATK buff.

title.zh: 按日珥打天光，足量才续
title.en: Spend actual Prominence on Celestial Light

input.zh: 合法EX/快支/Q后且日珥≥30长按普攻直进第三段；连携后可点按或长按。
input.en: After a legal EX/Quick Assist/Ultimate with 30+ Prominence, hold Basic into stage 3; after Chain, press or hold is valid.

trigger.zh: 实际日珥至少30且前置快捷入口成立；普通直接长按从第一段开始。
trigger.en: Actual Prominence is at least 30 and the shortcut entry exists; a standalone hold instead begins at stage 1.

complete.zh: 确认第三段已经发动；切控后才自动续第四段。没有切人则让动作正常完成。
complete.en: Confirm stage 3 activated; switching during it makes stage 4 continue off-field. Without switching, let the action finish normally.

reason.zh: 阳炎期间在第四段仍有≥30日珥才可长按再接第三段，不默认两套。
reason.en: During Mirage, another stage-3 loop from stage 4 requires 30+ remaining Prominence; two batches are not automatic.

fallback.zh: 资源不足跳过、回普攻积累；前置已断则用普通完整天光或重新取得快捷入口，后台续招未开始不作合轴。
fallback.en: If underfunded, skip and rebuild with Basics. If the shortcut expired, use the full normal sequence or regain an entry; no background continuation is assumed before startup.

label.zh: 嘉音切控后仍在前场驻唱；队友真实支援/连携入场且嘉音耗25能量，才给该入场角色加攻。
label.en: Astra stays on stage in Cadenza after control changes; an actual assist/Chain entry and her 25-Energy spend are required for that entrant’s ATK buff.

title.zh: 可选右Q：在失衡结束前收尾
title.en: Optional rightward Ultimate: finish before Stun ends

input.zh: 本人的第二次Q实际就绪且目标仍失衡时，按Q选向右，留足动作命中时间。
input.en: Only with another personal Ultimate ready and the target still Stunned, choose rightward and leave time for the hit.

trigger.zh: 上Q/天光之后仍有足够喧响，目标尚未恢复；不按固定0.01秒冒险。
trigger.en: Enough Decibels remain after the prior actions and the target has not recovered; do not use an assumed 0.01s timing.

complete.zh: 招式发动使当前失衡目标延长3秒；重击命中失衡目标才决算，终结一击命中结束失衡。
complete.en: Activation extends currently Stunned targets by 3s; its heavy hit needs a Stunned target for the payoff, and the finishing hit ends Stun.

reason.zh: 这是有资源的收尾选择，不把延长放到命中之后，也不让已恢复目标重新失衡。
reason.en: This is a resource-dependent finisher: extension occurs on activation, not on hit, and does not re-Stun recovered targets.

fallback.zh: 无Q或目标已恢复就跳过，保留资源进常态循环；不要为照表收尾强等导致漏掉现有输出。
fallback.en: Skip if unavailable or the target recovered; retain resources for the normal cycle instead of waiting solely to complete the script.

label.zh: 嘉音切控后仍在前场驻唱；队友真实支援/连携入场且嘉音耗25能量，才给该入场角色加攻。
label.en: Astra stays on stage in Cadenza after control changes; an actual assist/Chain entry and her 25-Energy spend are required for that entrant’s ATK buff.

prep.zh: 先确认敌人真实失衡、耀斑与辅助覆盖；嘉音Q未好时跳过其三步转换，可用真实敌人连携进入佩，再核对本人喧响。
prep.en: First verify actual Stun, Sunflare and support coverage. Without Astra Ultimate, skip the three conversion steps; a real enemy Chain can enter Pyrois, then recheck his own Decibels.

prep.zh: 阳炎有效且第四段时仍有30日珥才续第三段；妮可场不足可按常态三段切妮方法刷新，但不得把被占用的时间或新快支当免费。
prep.en: Only loop stage 3 from stage 4 with active Mirage and 30 remaining Prominence. Refresh Nicole via the normal overlap if needed, accounting for its time and actual assist instead of granting it freely.

text.zh: 嘉音1影入战增加1000自身喧响且攻击命中叠减抗；仍以本人Q实际就绪为准，不保证每轮有Q。
text.en: Astra M1 adds 1000 personal starting Decibels and hit-based resistance reduction; her actual Ultimate readiness still governs, with no guarantee every cycle.

text.zh: 嘉音4影在连携/Q后15秒可无和弦触发快支；不代表无能量也能支付核心加攻的25点。
text.en: Astra M4 allows assists without Chords for 15s after Chain/Ultimate, but does not waive the 25-Energy requirement for the core ATK proc.

text.zh: 玲珑妆匣在任意队员合法支援/连携入场时回能（有冷却）；实际消耗至少25能量才叠全队增伤，不默认开场两层。
text.en: Elegant Vanity restores Energy on any teammate’s valid assist/Chain entry, subject to cooldown; its team damage stacks require actual spending of at least 25 Energy, not automatic opening stacks.

text.zh: 佩1影进场加1000本人喧响；是否立即可开下Q仍看当前模式与实际资源，不照搬作者开场值。
text.en: Pyrois M1 adds 1000 starting personal Decibels; whether downward Ultimate is immediately available still depends on the mode and actual gauge.

text.zh: 佩2影下Q回1500喧响且有180秒冷却，上限增1000；不是每轮下Q都退款，也不保证失衡内双Q。
text.en: Pyrois M2 refunds 1500 Decibels on downward Ultimate with a 180s cooldown and adds 1000 capacity; it is not an every-cycle refund or guaranteed double Ultimate.

text.zh: 佩4影只有EX突进实际完美格挡才获得护盾，持有该护盾才增加失衡值；普通EX命中不等价。
text.en: Pyrois M4 grants its shield only on an actual EX Perfect Block; the Daze bonus requires that shield, not merely an ordinary EX hit.

text.zh: 日冕遗蜕在佩洛伊斯进入接战或发动终结技时给日蚀，持续45秒并无视以太抗性；不是无视防御，亦不额外回喧响。
text.en: Sol Exuvia gives Pyrois Eclipse on entering combat or Ultimate use for 45s of Ether resistance ignore; this is not DEF ignore and grants no extra Decibels.

text.zh: 妮可1影蓄力延长能量场，但蓄力继续耗能；依据覆盖需要，不固定要求每次长蓄。
text.en: Nicole M1 charging extends the field but still spends Energy; charge for needed coverage, not automatically every time.

text.zh: 妮可6影能量场实际造成伤害才逐层给对目标暴击率，最多10层各自12秒；不因放场立刻计满15%。
text.en: Nicole M6 builds target-specific CRIT Rate only on actual field damage, up to ten independently timed 12s stacks; placing the field does not immediately grant 15%.

text.zh: 聚宝箱由EX/连携/Q实际以太伤害刷新目标增伤，持续2秒；不能把短覆盖当整段常驻。
text.en: The Vault refreshes its 2s target damage effect on actual Ether damage from EX/Chain/Ultimate; the short coverage is not automatically permanent.

ROTATION_LESSON_TITLES.嘉音点E驻唱，命中后交快支: 点特殊技驻唱，命中后等快支
ROTATION_LESSON_TITLES.按提示接快速支援: 看到对应角色快支提示再接
ROTATION_LESSON_TITLES.嘉音Q：开启两次共享转换: 嘉音开终结技，按实际提示交棒
ROTATION_LESSON_TITLES.妮可EX命中，能量场接主攻: 妮可强化特殊技命中，等佩洛伊斯快支
ROTATION_LESSON_TITLES.可选下Q：先建立耀斑: 按终结技后选向下分支
ROTATION_LESSON_TITLES.按日珥打天光，足量才续: 至少30日珥时长按普攻接第三段
ROTATION_LESSON_TITLES.佩洛伊斯普攻，积攒日珥与喧响: 点普攻积攒日珥与喧响
ROTATION_LESSON_TITLES.日华：可选接攻击，建立天光快捷入口: 有能量时点强化特殊技；想格挡就对准来招
ROTATION_LESSON_TITLES.天光第三段启动后切妮可: 长按普攻接第三段，启动后切妮可
ROTATION_LESSON_TITLES.接妮可连携，命中再给佩洛伊斯: 看到转换连携提示时选妮可
ROTATION_LESSON_TITLES.佩洛伊斯连携，补本人喧响: 实际出现连携时选佩洛伊斯
ROTATION_LESSON_TITLES.上Q补日珥，建立阳炎爆发: 敌人失衡时按终结技，选向上分支
ROTATION_LESSON_TITLES.可选右Q：在失衡结束前收尾: 第二次终结技已就绪时选向右分支

ROTATION_LESSON_INPUTS.仅在该角色快支提示出现时按切换键。: 看到指向该角色的快速支援提示时，按对应切换键。
ROTATION_LESSON_INPUTS.嘉音本人Q就绪时切回发动，确保命中；按随后提示接指定角色。: 需要开启转换、嘉音自己的终结技就绪时，切回嘉音按终结技并命中，再看随后出现哪位队友的提示。
ROTATION_LESSON_INPUTS.妮可能量足时点按EX；需要更长能量场且有余能才蓄力，命中后接佩洛伊斯快支。: 妮可能量够时点按强化特殊技；需要更长的能量场且有余能才蓄力。命中并出现佩洛伊斯的快支提示后，再按支援键。
ROTATION_LESSON_INPUTS.本人喧响到特且Q可选时按Q，选向下分支。: 本人的喧响到「特」、终结技可用时按终结技，选向下分支。
ROTATION_LESSON_INPUTS.合法EX/快支/Q后且日珥≥30长按普攻直进第三段；连携后可点按或长按。: 在强化特殊技、快支或终结技后，日珥至少30时长按普攻直进第三段；连携后则可点按或长按普攻。
ROTATION_LESSON_INPUTS.EX能量够时点按；若要完美格挡，必须让突进期间实际接到敌人攻击。: 能量足够时点按强化特殊技；要触发完美格挡，须让突进期间实际接到敌人攻击。
ROTATION_LESSON_INPUTS.合法EX/快支/Q后且日珥≥30，长按普攻直进第三段；确认启动再切妮可。: 强化特殊技、快支或终结技后，日珥至少30时长按普攻直进第三段；看到第三段已经启动，再切妮可。
ROTATION_LESSON_INPUTS.嘉音Q命中出现妮可的转换连携提示时按提示进入。: 嘉音终结技命中后，若出现妮可的转换连携提示，选妮可入场。
ROTATION_LESSON_INPUTS.实际连携提示可选佩洛伊斯时进入。: 连携选人中有佩洛伊斯时，选他入场。
ROTATION_LESSON_INPUTS.佩洛伊斯本人Q就绪且目标失衡时按Q，选向上分支。: 佩洛伊斯自己的终结技就绪且敌人仍失衡时，按终结技并选向上分支。
ROTATION_LESSON_INPUTS.本人的第二次Q实际就绪且目标仍失衡时，按Q选向右，留足动作命中时间。: 自己的第二次终结技已就绪、敌人仍失衡时，按终结技并选向右分支；要留够动作命中的时间。

ROTATION_RECOVERY_INPUTS.1031: 需要补能量场且能量够时，点按强化特殊技并命中；尚未出现连携窗口就不要按连携选人。
ROTATION_RECOVERY_INPUTS.1551: 先点普攻命中积日珥；至少30日珥且已有合法衔接入口，才长按普攻接第三段。

ROTATION_ADAPTED_INPUTS.103100004: 能量够时点按强化特殊技，等能量场命中
ROTATION_ADAPTED_INPUTS.131100005: 点按特殊技，等攻击命中并进入驻唱
ROTATION_ADAPTED_INPUTS.131100012: 喧响到「极」且终结技就绪时点按终结技，等命中

155100001: 本步点普攻命中积日珥；按积到的资源停手，不要求先打满几段才能放强化特殊技。
Land Basics for the resource here. Stop by actual resources, not a fixed Basic count before EX.
155100002: 至少30日珥：在强化特殊技、快支或终结技后长按普攻，直接进第三段；连携后也可点按。不是在强化特殊技前先点三次。
At 30 or more resource, hold Basic after EX, Quick Assist or Ultimate to enter hit 3 directly. Tapping after Chain is also possible. No three taps before EX.

1551: 缺日珥才用普攻积攒；至少30日珥且有快捷入口时，长按普攻直达第三段，不必重打前两段。
Use Basics if resource is missing. At 30 and with the shortcut available, hold Basic to go straight to hit 3.
